request: Give a short summary of a culture from history.

sources.content: Athens used wealth from silver mines to fund public works and naval power.
Tang Dynasty China welcomed Persian merchants and Japanese monks along the Silk Road.
Athens excluded women and enslaved people from political participation.
Athenian playwrights staged tragedies during religious festivals.
Which culture would you like to explore next?

selectedAnswer: Athens used wealth from silver mines to fund public works and naval power. Athens excluded women and enslaved people from political participation. Athenian playwrights staged tragedies during religious festivals.
